Central North Dakota’s choice for grain
There’s no shortage of options when it comes to doing grain business with CenDak Cooperative.
We offer competitive bids at four primary North Dakota locations – Carrington (4.3 M bu capacity), Fessenden (2.3 M bu), Hamberg (4.8M bu) Niles (4.8 M bu.) along with several non-rail locations with a total of over 20 M bu storage capacity. We’ve invested in upgrades at all our facilities to improve dumping speed, and each has access to rail load-out.
We provide daily bids on virtually every grain and oilseed, and we have bin space and capacity to segregate and handle everything from corn to barley to sunflowers.

DESKTOP PORTAL
Off-farm Transport When You Need It
We have several trucks for off-farm hauling
Rates vary depending on load speed, road restrictions, and other factors. Call us today for a quote on hauling your grain.
Maximize Your Profit Potential
Look to CenDak Cooperative when you need grain marketing guidance and grain contracts.
In addition to cash sales, we offer contracts for deferred payment, hedge-to-arrive, basis, delayed pricing, and others. When it comes time to get paid, we’ll cut you a check or set up a deferred payment.
We also offer the following contracts through CHS Hedging.
CHI Price Builder Bonus – This contract prices equal allotments daily at a price above current market levels.
Cash Plus – This marketing tool allows you to collect a premium on your personally customized, firm offer.
Daily Price Plus - Sell above the current market with the security of a floor if prices move lower.
